Pick a face or part, then ask AI to lengthen/extend. Edits stay locked to the selected object instead of regenerating from an old baseline.

title: Metallic gen loader + ready banner
discord:
**New in Render3D — Generation HUD**
Bottom-right metallic loader with a mini printer + robot: the part prints with the progress bar, then the robot picks & places at 100%. When the model is ready, a status banner fades in above it.

👉 [Click here to try it](https://render3d.app/)
Updates: https://render3d.app/updates.html
linkedin:
A small UX detail that changes how AI CAD feels in Render3D:
